notes.title: ⚔️ North Hunt Devlog Series Begins - Viking Chaos Awaits!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45666020/230d9954cd1ea2ed4266edde4493cde24be91501.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re beyond excited to announce the start of our North Hunt Devlog series, a behind-the-scenes look at the Viking-era sequel to West Hunt![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45666020/e35429691c1a31c117cd3c2483a6391cbad84051.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] Watch the First Devlog Here: [/p][previewyoutube="i8CngRsYXSw;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]In this very first episode, we reveal:[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p] Chief vs. Thief Gameplay, the classic hunt reimagined in a Viking setting.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p] Overhauled Movement & Animations,smoother, snappier, and more alive than ever.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p] Unique Classes & Abilities, disguise, deceive, trap, and outsmart with powerful new roles.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p] Revamped UI & Matchmaking ,faster menus and lobbies to get you into the action quicker.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p] Same Hilarious Chaos, Viking Style,  the tension you loved in West Hunt, now with axes, longships, and Norse mythology-level drama.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning , we’ll be sharing regular devlogs to keep you in the loop as North Hunt evolves with new features, gameplay updates, and community insights.[/p][p] Wishlist North Hunt now on Steam: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642850/North_Hunt/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We can’t wait to share this journey with you. Welcome to the hunt, Viking style.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]– The NewGen Studio Team (Published by PerfectGen)[/p]
